whyEcuador.title: The Ecuadorian Aquaculture Advantage
whyEcuador.subtitle: Ecuador is the world's 4th largest shrimp exporter. Unique tropical conditions, clean water and certified producers make Guayas the preferred origin for international buyers.

items.label: 4th Largest Exporter
items.desc: Ecuador exports over 1.2 million tons of shrimp annually — the EU's top supplier and a major source for Asia.

items.label: Optimal Temperature
items.desc: Water between 24–28°C year-round in Guayas. Shorter production cycles and better feed conversion than regional competitors.

items.label: BAP Certification
items.desc: Farms and laboratories audited under BAP, HACCP and BRC standards. Documentation ready for the EU, US and Asia without delays.

items.label: Direct FOB Logistics
items.desc: Port of Guayaquil with weekly sailings. Miami commercial office to streamline operations with North American buyers.

process.title: From Your Request to Shipment in 4 Steps
process.description: A clear, agile commercial process with technical support at every stage.

steps.title: Request Your Quote
steps.description: Select the products, indicate volume and destination country. You will receive a response within 24 hours.

steps.title: Technical & Commercial Validation
steps.description: Our team validates availability, required certifications and Incoterms according to your market.

steps.description: You receive a proposal with FOB price, technical specifications, certifications and export documentation.

steps.title: Dispatch & Tracking
steps.description: We coordinate the shipment, international logistics and follow up until the product reaches its destination.
